everyCategoryHasItems.detail: Every approved category resolves at least one item

validArabicText.detail: Every item contains non-empty Arabic text

positiveSafeIntegerTargets.detail: Every target count is a positive safe integer

noReplacementCharacters.detail: No religious text contains the Unicode replacement character

noUnsafeHtml.detail: Religious text contains no HTML or scriptable URL content

categoryTotalsDerivedFromData.detail: Every displayed total is sourced from the normalized catalog

everyRouteResolvesCategory.detail: Every generated /azkar/[category] route resolves its category and items

validLegacyMigration.detail: Valid legacy counter data migrates to the versioned category model

invalidStoredCountsSanitized.detail: Above-target counts clamp; negative, string, and unknown-item counts are rejected

unknownIdsDoNotCrash.detail: Unknown category and item IDs are ignored without discarding valid categories

duplicateRecordsMerged.detail: Duplicate legacy category records merge safely using valid bounded counts
